h1.h1-text: What is multimodal AI? How models combine text, images, and audio,

hero.hero-sub: Multimodal AI is the architecture that enables models to process and reason across text, images, and audio simultaneously—instead of treating each modality in isolation. I design and build production multimodal systems: data fusion, cross-modal retrieval, generation, and integration.
hero.live: Every modality is aligned and grounded, safety built in from day one.
